context: Reflecting on lessons from the disaster
purpose: Draw lessons; teach 発電/爆発/電力/損害/デモ/受信/知事/表明

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一連の事故、社会に多くを問いかけたね。
lines.en: The whole accident asked society a lot.
lines.style: reflective friend pondering, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 発電のあり方、見直す時期だと思う。
lines.en: It’s time to rethink how we generate power.
lines.style: thoughtful friend proposing, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 爆発のような事故を、二度と起こしたくない。
lines.en: I never want another explosion like that.
lines.style: resolved friend, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 電力に頼り切る生活も、考え直さなきゃ。
lines.en: A life relying on power must be rethought.
lines.style: friend offering a wider view, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 被害者の損害が、早く補償されるといい。
lines.en: I hope victims’ damages are compensated soon.
lines.style: compassionate friend hoping, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 平和的なデモが、社会を動かすんだね。
lines.style: friend recognizing the power of voice

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 速報を受信する習慣も、身についた。
lines.en: I’ve gained the habit of receiving alerts.
lines.style: friend noting a personal change, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 知事や国の表明を、これからも見ていきたい。
lines.en: I want to keep watching the governor’s and the country’s announcements.
lines.style: engaged friend committing, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
